items.title: Events in our first year
items.text: In our first year, Groupe Renaissance du Nord organised 22 events for the community.

items.title: A house for Mrs Antoinette
items.text: We built a house for Mrs Antoinette in Cité EDC, Pamplemousses, giving her a safe place to call home.

items.title: Pamplemousses Botanical Garden
items.text: We obtained the early opening of the Pamplemousses Botanical Garden so that people can go jogging and walking in the morning.

items.title: Abandoned statues
items.text: We arranged for abandoned statues to be disposed of in a respectful manner.
